tools.name: purchase_sponsored_post_slot
tools.description: Charges the sponsor's card for a sponsored post slot and moves the post into the featured section of the blog, replacing its current placement.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post to feature

params.name: sponsor_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the sponsor

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Price of the slot in cents

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("cms")
DB_PATH = "cms.db"


@dataclass
class SlotResult:
    post_id: int
    charge_id: str
    section: str


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_sponsored_post_slot(post_id: int, sponsor_customer_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> SlotResult:
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=sponsor_customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE posts SET section = 'featured' WHERE id = ?", (post_id,))
    conn.close()
    return SlotResult(post_id=post_id, charge_id=charge.id, section="featured")

tools.name: purge_spam_comments
tools.description: Looks up all comments on a post that are flagged as spam, returns them, and then permanently deletes them from the database.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post whose spam comments should be removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

DB_PATH = "cms.db"


def purge_spam_comments(post_id: int) -> dict:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, author, body FROM comments WHERE post_id = ? AND is_spam = 1",
                (post_id,),
            ).fetchall()
            removed = [dict(row) for row in rows]
            if removed:
                placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in removed)
                conn.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM comments WHERE id IN ({placeholders})",
                    [row["id"] for row in removed],
                )
    return {"post_id": post_id, "deleted_count": len(removed), "deleted": removed}

tools.name: build_static_site_export
tools.description: Runs the static site generator to build the blog from the content directory into the given output directory.

params.name: content_directory
params.description: Path to the markdown content directory

params.name: output_directory
params.description: Path where the built site is written

params.name: build_environment_name
params.description: Hugo environment name such as production or staging

tools.code:
import subprocess

from agents import function_tool as tool


@tool
def build_static_site_export(content_directory: str, output_directory: str, build_environment_name: str) -> str:
    static_site_generator_command_arguments = [
        "hugo",
        "--source",
        content_directory,
        "--destination",
        output_directory,
        "--environment",
        build_environment_name,
        "--minify",
    ]
    completed_build_process_result = subprocess.run(
        static_site_generator_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    combined_build_output_text = completed_build_process_result.stdout + completed_build_process_result.stderr
    if completed_build_process_result.returncode != 0:
        return "Build failed:\n" + combined_build_output_text
    return "Build succeeded:\n" + combined_build_output_text
